::: {#sol-palindrome}

Apply @thm-negate-quantifiers twice, from the outside in.
First, the negation has the truth value of
$$
\exists s \in W,\ \neg (\exists t \in W,\ s t \text{ is a palindrome}).
$$
For each word $s$, @thm-negate-quantifiers says that
$\neg (\exists t \in W,\ s t \text{ is a palindrome})$
has the truth value of
$\forall t \in W,\ s t \text{ is not a palindrome}$.
These have the same truth value for every $s$,
so the $\exists s$ propositions built from them do too (@def-existential-quantifier),
and the negation has the truth value of
$$
\exists s \in W,\ \forall t \in W,\ s t \text{ is not a palindrome}.
$$
In English: some word cannot be made into a palindrome by adding letters at its end.

:::
